status: Paced synthetic loopback runs with in-memory and file-backed H2.
result: Each store accepted 208 events with zero errors across concurrency 1, 4 and 8. At concurrency 8, p95 was 131.90 ms in memory and 233.17 ms on disk. In both runs the quota returned HTTP 429 on the 61st request from a separate client.
limitations: Three eight-second stages per store on one workstation, paced at up to 16 events per second. These figures describe fixture behavior. Docker and deployed PostgreSQL recovery remain unverified.
